svg.title: Harbor Goods GenAI architecture and cost review: exports to fixes
svg.desc: Read-only exports of a Bedrock workload (settings, IAM role, application logs, three months of the bill and a golden-set evaluation) feed offline scripted checks against the Well-Architected Generative AI Lens: 17 best practices reviewed, 6 met, and the smaller Haiku model passes the quality bar on the ask route. Eleven findings are ranked by risk, then saving, and each ships with Terraform or application code; the cost model takes the monthly bill from $20.3k to $7.0k, and make verify reproduces every number.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS · GENAI ARCHITECTURE + COST REVIEW
